blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Substance / Story

blocks.source: アニマと呼ばれる魔法の力を人が当たり前の様に持つ世界。その中で、主人公の１人ギュスターヴは王家に生まれるが、アニマの力を持たなかったため、国を追放される事になる。という、ファンタジー世界のお約束を逆手に取った設定。
blocks.translation: A world where people naturally possess magical powers called Anima. In this world, one of the protagonists, Gustave, is born into the royal family but is banished from the country because he lacks the power of Anima. It is a setting that cleverly turns a classic fantasy-world premise on its head.

blocks.source: 物語はこのギュスターヴ編の他に、冒険者ウィル・ナイツとその子孫を中心としたナイツ編の二面で展開する事になる。というか、プレイヤーが操作するのは主にナイツ編の方で、ギュスターヴ編は見ているだけのイベントが多い。『二面展開』と『世代交代』という２つの複雑な要素を織り交ぜており独特の魅力を持っている。ただ、それがゲームの遊びにくさに繋がっている部分も。
blocks.translation: In addition to Gustave's story, the narrative unfolds through the Knights story, centered on the adventurer Will Knights and his descendants. In fact, players mainly control the Knights story, while the Gustave story contains many events that are simply watched. It combines two complex elements—its “dual narrative” and “generational succession”—giving it a unique appeal. However, these elements also contribute to the game's difficulty to play.

blocks.source: 同じく３世代もののストーリーといえば、ＤＱ５が有名だが、あちらは３世代の中心に主人公を据えることで安定した構成になっている。対してサガフロ２では、主人公となるキャラクターがコロコロ変わるので、取り付く島がない。そこそこの主要人物がいつの間にか、フェードアウトしていたりと消化不良感も。せめて、３世代ではなく、２世代に終わらせれば無難にまとまったんじゃないかというのが、個人的な思いつき。
blocks.translation: When it comes to stories spanning three generations, Dragon Quest V is famous. That game maintains a stable structure by placing the protagonist at the center of the three generations. SaGa Frontier 2, by contrast, constantly switches the character serving as the protagonist, making it difficult to get invested. Some fairly important characters also fade out before you realize it, leaving a sense of frustration. Personally, I suspect it might have come together more smoothly if it had ended after two generations instead of three.

blocks.source: 前作までに存在したフリーシナリオは実質的には無くなっている。ある程度、選ぶシナリオに自由はあるけれど、話の順番を無視すると意味不明になってしまう。そもそもイベント数自体がさほどでも無く、全体としても短い。２０時間もあれば終わるかと思うけど、僕の場合、その１／３以上はラスボス戦とその準備に当てられた。
blocks.translation: The free-scenario system that existed in the previous games has effectively disappeared. You have some freedom in choosing scenarios, but ignoring their order makes the story incomprehensible. The number of events itself is not particularly large, and the game is short overall. I think it can be completed in about 20 hours, but in my case, more than a third of that time was spent on the final boss battle and preparing for it.

blocks.source: 他のサガシリーズだけではなく、普通のＲＰＧと比べても、好きな時に好きな町に入れないなど、自由度はかなり低め。技や術、レアアイテムの数は意外に多くあるけど、逆に言うと出し惜しみし過ぎじゃないかなと。
blocks.translation: Compared not only with other SaGa games but also with ordinary RPGs, the degree of freedom is quite low—you cannot even enter towns whenever you want. There are surprisingly many techniques, spells, and rare items, but conversely, it feels like the game is holding back too much.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Playability

blocks.source: 装備品が持つ属性の組み合わせによって、術が使用できるようになる。毎ターンＷＰとＪＰが回復していくので、消費が多い技・術以外は気にせずに使用する事もできる。戦闘・強化システムは良くできているし、世界観にもマッチしている。ただ、それを発揮する機会に乏しいのがもったいない。
blocks.translation: Spells become available based on combinations of attributes possessed by equipment. Since WP and JP recover every turn, you can use anything other than techniques and spells with high costs without worrying about consumption. The battle and enhancement systems are well designed and fit the game's world perfectly. It is a shame, however, that there are so few opportunities to make full use of them.

blocks.source: 閃きや連携などといった要素は健在。１対１のデュエルでは選択したコマンド次第で新しい技を閃く可能性もある。ただし、戦闘テンポはシリーズ中でも遅めで、前作と比較して連携のスピーディさでは劣る。
blocks.translation: Elements such as glimmers and combos remain intact. In one-on-one duels, you may even discover a new technique depending on the commands you choose. However, the battle tempo is on the slower side even within the series, and the combos are less speedy than in the previous game.

blocks.source: ＬＰを消費する事で、ターンを消費せずにＨＰを全快する事ができるなんて珍しい要素もある。なかなか全滅しないので戦闘が長引く原因になっている気もするけど……。
blocks.translation: There is also the unusual feature of being able to fully restore HP without spending a turn by consuming LP. Since it is difficult to suffer a total party defeat, though, this may also be one reason battles drag on…

blocks.source: 問題は複雑で落ち着きのないシナリオ面が、ゲームシステムを楽しむには辛いこと。シナリオの都合上、ダンジョンから脱出できないことが多いのは困りもの。
blocks.translation: The problem is that the complex and restless scenario makes it difficult to enjoy the game system. Due to the scenario's structure, it is often impossible to escape from a dungeon, which is troublesome.

blocks.source: 「町を拠点にパーティを鍛えて、強敵に挑む」といったＲＰＧでは、当たり前の楽しみ方はほとんどできない。こういう一本道ＲＰＧならば、要所に回復場所があると便利なのだけど、特に配慮がないのが辛い。
blocks.translation: In an RPG where you “use a town as your base, train your party, and challenge powerful enemies,” you can barely enjoy this basic style of play at all. In a linear RPG like this, recovery points placed at key locations would be convenient, but the lack of any such consideration is frustrating.

blocks.source: 世代交代をシステムに活かした作品としては、ロマサガ２やＦＥ聖戦があるが、これらはシステムとシナリオを上手に融合させている。そう考えると、もっとうまくやれるゲームデザインがあったのではないかと思ってしまう。
blocks.translation: Romancing SaGa 2 and Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War are examples of games that make use of generational succession as a system, and they skillfully integrate their systems with their scenarios. Thinking about that, I cannot help but feel that there could have been a game design that handled it more effectively.

blocks.source: 後半までは、一部のボスが強いくらいで、さほど難易度は高くない。時間を掛けてパーティを鍛えずとも、支障なく先に進む事ができる……がそれは大きな罠。ラストダンジョンではＬＰ（0になると戦闘に参加できない）が回復できない上に、ラスボスも非常に強く、ハマリの可能性がある。シリーズ中でのラスボスの強さとしては、ロマサガ２に継ぐのだが、クイックタイムの様な強力な救済策は存在しない。
blocks.translation: Up until the latter half, the difficulty is not particularly high, aside from a few powerful bosses. You can progress without trouble even without spending time training your party… but that is a major trap. In the final dungeon, LP (if it reaches 0, you cannot participate in battle) cannot be restored, and the final boss is extremely powerful, so you can potentially become stuck. In terms of final-boss strength within the series, it ranks just below Romancing SaGa 2, but there is no powerful safety net like Quick Time.

blocks.source: そんなわけで、ラストダンジョンに進む前にある程度鍛える。または、ラストダンジョンではＬＰを減らさないように慎重に鍛えるか、のどちらかにしないと詰む。……というか筆者は詰みました。でも、最初からやり直したとしても、さっさと進めれば１０時間も掛からずにラストまで来れる短さ。
blocks.translation: For that reason, you must either train to a certain extent before entering the final dungeon, or train carefully inside it without reducing your LP; otherwise, you will be stuck. …Actually, I got stuck myself. Even if you start over from the beginning, however, the game is short enough that you can reach the end in under 10 hours if you move quickly.

blocks.source: ギュスターヴ編の戦争イベントでは、シミュレーション的なシステムで戦闘が行われる。これの最後の戦闘はかなり難易度が高い。今ならネットで調べれば、攻略法もすぐに分かるけど当時はクリアできないという声も多かった。ちなみに筆者は独力で頑張って何とかしました。
blocks.translation: During the war events in Gustave's story, battles are fought using a simulation-style system. The final battle in this sequence is quite difficult. These days, you can quickly find a strategy by searching online, but at the time, many people said they could not clear it. Incidentally, I managed to overcome it through my own efforts.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: 独特の画風（水墨画調などと呼ばれる）による２Ｄグラフィックで、温かみがある。戦闘アニメーションも中々美しく、かつ数も豊富。グラフィックが荒削りだった前作と比較して、上品になった感がある。
blocks.translation: The 2D graphics use a distinctive art style, sometimes described as resembling ink-wash paintings, and have a warm quality. The battle animations are quite beautiful and plentiful as well. Compared with the previous game's rougher graphics, this feels more refined.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 全体を通したメロディーラインの共有が特徴。癒される。町の曲やラストバトルなど秀逸。美術と音楽の水準が非常に高いので、雰囲気ゲーと呼ばれる事も。
blocks.translation: One notable feature is the recurring melodic line shared throughout the game. It is soothing. The town themes and final battle music are particularly excellent. Since the quality of the art and music is extremely high, the game is sometimes called an atmospheric experience.
